title: Blockchain for transparency in LLM
description: Blockchain's immutable record-keeping allows participants to track the training process. This can ensure responsible AI development practices and avoid biases introduced through specific datasets.
keywords: track source of data for llm training

title: Blockchain: Revolutionizing Supply Chain Transparency
description: Blockchain technology revolutionizes supply chain lineage by providing transparency, traceability, and immutability, addressing traditional challenges such as fraud, inefficiencies, and lack of real-time data sharing. Its adoption enhances consumer trust, regulatory compliance, cost efficiency, and sustainability across industries, paving the way for a more accountable and optimized global supply chain.

title: Blockchain Overview :
description: Imagine a giant spreadsheet, constantly being updated and replicated across a vast network of computers, where everyone has a copy and can see the changes. That is essentially what a blockchain is.
